rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The PT portal reports that the posse act took place on the night of Friday 19 February 2010, within the 4th Congress at the Centro de Convenções Ulysses Guimarães, when the new president José Eduardo Dutra and the 81 members of the new National Directorate were invested ('foram empossados').

locator.section: Item body, second paragraph ('O ato ocorreu na noite desta sexta-feira (19) ... quando foram empossados o novo presidente José Eduardo Dutra e os 81 membros do novo DN')

rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The same report describes 'O deputado federal Ricardo Berzoini, que deixa a presidência do partido' as reviewing the party's history at the act.

locator.section: Item body, paragraph beginning 'O deputado federal Ricardo Berzoini'

rows.role_title: Presidente Nacional do Partido dos Trabalhadores
rows.text: The report of 19 February 2010 says Dutra, in his posse speech, paid tribute to all the presidents in the PT's history, naming Lula, Olívio Dutra, Rui Falcão, Luiz Gushiken, Tarso Genro, José Dirceu, José Genoíno and Berzoini.

locator.section: Item body, paragraph beginning 'O presidente empossado, José Eduardo Dutra'
